title: God Calls Us Deeper
verse: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep water and lower your nets for a catch.
observation: Jesus was telling them to go back out to where they had previously been unsuccessful. However, this time was different. This time, the Lord was with them. Many times, the Lord will have us go back into a world that has not always been kind, helpful, or easy. However, this time is different. This time, the Lord is with us. What would it look like if you went into your world today, but this time you realize the Lord is with you? Would it change how you talked with people? Would it change your level of confidence when encountering difficulty? This doesn’t mean it will always be easy. Problems will come. People will be hard. Issues will arise. However, you can have the confidence that nothing will stop the Lord from walking beside you whispering, “You’re never alone. I am here and will never leave.”
application: Walk into your world with the confident joy that the Holy Spirit is walking right beside you today.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being our Lord, Savior, King, and Friend.
